entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A tormented werewolf planeswalker from Kessig on Innistrad and protector of the Ulvenwald.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Leader of the Mondronen werewolf pack who mentored Arlinn and later launched the Harvesttide attack.

entities.name: Mondronen werewolf pack
entities.description: Tovolar's werewolf pack whose howls summoned Arlinn into the forest.

entities.name: Patience
entities.description: Arlinn's dire wolf pack mate who stayed apart from Tovolar's pack.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: Leader of the Dawnhart Coven.

entities.name: Dawnhart Coven
entities.description: A coven of witches led by Katilda who perform the Harvesttide ritual.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Gatewatch who helps Arlinn and casts a spell to delay the sunset.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Gatewatch who helps Arlinn find the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Gatewatch who helps Arlinn.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers Arlinn asks for help.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: A cathar who joins Arlinn's search for the Key.

entities.name: Worrin Betzold
entities.description: A bishop, an old friend of Arlinn, turned zombie, whom she kills out of mercy.

entities.name: Dennick Betzold
entities.description: The bishop's son, now a spirit in the haunted family mansion.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire who was given the Moonsilver Key and allies with Arlinn in Crimson Vow.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel who appears in answer to Arlinn's prayer and confronts Sorin.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who takes the Moonsilver Key, beginning the Eternal Night.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's grandfather, taken by Olivia and wed to her.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: A key sought by Arlinn's group, needed to complete the Harvesttide ritual.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Arlinn's home plane.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: Province of Innistrad where Arlinn is from.

entities.name: Celestus
entities.description: Site of the Harvesttide ritual.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Sorin's home where the Key is found.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: Ruined city searched for clues about the Key.

entities.name: Eternal Night
entities.description: Began when Olivia took the Key and the Harvesttide ritual failed.

entities.name: Harvesttide Massacre
entities.description: Tovolar's attack on the Harvesttide festival.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where Arlinn was trapped during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon planeswalker whose Immortal Sun trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi sealed in the Moon of Innistrad, causing changes to night and day.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel whose church launched an inquisition against werewolves.

events.summary: As a teenager Arlinn is summoned by Tovolar's pack's howls and completes her First Hunt.
events.quote: Arlinn was a teenager from Avabruck when the howls of Tovolar 's Mondronen werewolf pack summoned her into the forest and she completed her First Hunt.

events.summary: Arlinn rejects Tovolar's urging to slaughter foresters, fights him and abandons the pack.
events.quote: Arlinn rejected that idea and fought Tovolar, leaving lasting scars on them both.

events.summary: At Havengul on the day she becomes an Archmage, Arlinn loses control, and her spark ignites.
events.quote: While fighting, she couldn't contain the change any longer and she killed devils, several hierarchs and an angel alike before her spark ignited

events.summary: Arlinn learns she can control her transformation away from Innistrad's moon, and returns to find her parents dead.
events.quote: Upon her return to Avabruck years later, she found that her parents had been killed in a fire at her father's forge.

events.summary: Arlinn fights the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde on Ravnica, trapped there by the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Alongside many other planeswalkers and Ravnicans, she fought against the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde .

events.summary: Arlinn remains on Ravnica to help the Gatewatch after Chandra disables the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: She was one of the few planeswalkers who chose to remain on Ravnica after Chandra disabled the Immortal Sun, helping the Gatewatch in their fight against Bolas.

events.summary: Tovolar invites Arlinn to a mass human hunt; she refuses and tries to attack him, and her wolves side with Tovolar.
events.quote: Tovolar invites Arlinn to join him and other werewolves in a massive human hunt in Kessig .

events.summary: Arlinn asks the Gatewatch for help finding the Moonsilver Key; Teferi, Kaya and Chandra agree.
events.quote: The three planeswalkers agree to help Arlinn and head to Innistrad.

events.summary: Arlinn kills the zombified Worrin Betzold out of mercy after learning the name Dennick.
events.quote: In an act of mercy she kills her friend so he can rest in peace.

events.summary: Sorin attacks Arlinn when Avacyn is mentioned; Sigarda appears and stops him.
events.quote: Again she mentions Avacyn and is attacked again, but this time Sigarda appears and stops the attack.

events.summary: Arlinn finds and takes the Moonsilver Key in Sorin's quarters.
Tovolar's army attacks the Harvesttide festival and the planeswalkers, cathars and witches fight the werewolves.
events.quote: Cathars, witches and planeswalkers fought the werewolves to protect the humans .

events.summary: Arlinn feigns surrender and overpowers Tovolar, who retreats with the pack.
events.quote: Arlinn feigned surrender, but then overpowered the unsuspecting Tovolar with a deathgrip in his chest.

events.summary: Arlinn throws the Key to Olivia to save Katilda, beginning the Eternal Night.
events.quote: Deciding quickly, Arlinn threw the Key to the vampire, and Olivia hurled Katilda's body to the ground.

events.summary: Arlinn and the group form a pact with Sorin against Olivia.
events.quote: They formed a pact with Sorin and travelled together to the wedding of Olivia and Edgar Markov at the Voldaren estate.

events.summary: Arlinn is outmatched by Olivia and impaled from behind.
events.quote: Distracted in shredding vampiric portraits, she was impaled from behind by Olivia's hand.

events.summary: Tovolar and the pack arrive to help; Olivia drops the Key and flees with Edgar.
events.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key and left with Edgar through one of the broken windows, barely escaping from the jaws of Tovolar.

events.summary: Teferi warns Arlinn of the returning Phyrexians.
events.quote: Before Teferi’s departure, he urged Arlinn to be on guard against the return of an old enemy, the Phyrexians .

events.summary: Arlinn and Sorin prepare Innistrad's defenses against the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Arlinn Kord and Sorin Markov worked together to prepare Innistrad's defenses against the encroaching Phyrexian Multiverse threat.

relations.note: Mentored her in the pack before she left.
relations.quote: For two years she stayed with the pack, though despite Tovolar's mentorship, she never fully embraced the violence of her werewolf nature.

relations.note: Refuses his hunt and fights him.
relations.quote: she refuses and tries to attack him, but the wolves of her pack come between her and Tovolar.

relations.note: Mercy killing of her zombified friend.
relations.quote: In an act of mercy she kills her friend so he can rest in peace.
helping the Gatewatch in their fight against Bolas.

relations.note: Pact in Crimson Vow and later defense of Innistrad.
relations.quote: Arlinn Kord and Sorin Markov worked together to prepare Innistrad's defenses against the encroaching Phyrexian Multiverse threat.
Confronting Olivia Voldaren for the Key, she found herself outmatched by the vampire's bladework and suffered multiple deep injuries.
Arlinn Kord is a tormented werewolf planeswalker from the Kessig province of the plane of Innistrad .
